categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the new energy sector, focusing on investment in new energy power stations, EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) projects for new energy, equipment sales for new energy power stations, and power station operation and maintenance services. It also engages in manufacturing and sales of photovoltaic equipment and related technical services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes technologies related to photovoltaic power generation, wind power projects, and new energy EPC construction. It employs engineering total contracting (EPC) methods, including design, procurement, and construction phases. The company also focuses on technical development, consulting, and promotion in new energy equipment manufacturing and installation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large state-owned enterprises and engineering companies such as Shanghai Electric Power Construction Co., Ltd. and China Power Construction Group. The company serves the renewable energy sector, particularly solar and wind power projects, with major projects in regions like Shanxi, Guizhou, and Inner Mongolia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with significant business in North China, East China, Northeast China, and Northwest China. It has subsidiaries and projects in provinces such as Jiangsu, Shanxi, Guizhou, Inner Mongolia, and Beijing.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the new energy supply chain, including EPC contracting, equipment manufacturing and sales, and operation and maintenance of new energy power stations. It also holds investments in power station assets, indicating involvement in asset management downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include accelerating project execution, enhancing cooperation with national and central enterprises in the new energy sector, and developing profitable high-quality projects. The company emphasizes improving sustainable operations and profitability through innovation in EPC services and power station asset management. It also implements a restricted stock incentive plan to motivate key personnel aligned with revenue and profit targets.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through EPC project contracts, sales of new energy power station equipment, and operation and maintenance service fees. The company recognizes revenue based on contract progress and service delivery, with a focus on long-term contracts in the renewable energy sector.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with leading domestic new energy EPC and operation service providers, including top-tier power construction groups. It positions itself as a specialized new energy EPC contractor and equipment supplier with integrated power station operation capabilities, aiming to strengthen cooperation with national and central enterprises to improve market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 161 million, a 56% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 27.3 million. The company faces significant financial challenges, including negative net assets and accumulated losses, leading to a risk warning on its stock. Despite this, it is actively pursuing project execution and business development to improve its financial health.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its integrated capabilities in new energy EPC, equipment manufacturing, and power station operation and maintenance, delivering value through efficient project execution and operational excellence. It highlights its ability to achieve power generation targets exceeding expectations, thereby generating excess returns for project owners and itself. The company also focuses on strategic partnerships with leading national enterprises to enhance its competitive edge.
